title: Phone: last message from {jo_short}
body:
Day 1, 23:12 — Jo: "They're keeping all of us at {st_agnes}. Don't come here, it's bad. I love you, grease monkey. Stay inside."

The phone died on day 6. You've read it a hundred times since.

title: Note taped to 2B's door
body: To whoever's still in this building: Mrs. Alvarez and I went to {firehouse9} on Alder Street. They have water and a fence. Head east past the depot. — Teodor, 2B

title: Break-room doodle
body:
A sketch on the back of a shift roster, in Marco's handwriting: a baseball bat with nails hammered through the sweet spot. "FOR THE RAIDERS GAME. or whatever comes."

You could build that at the depot workbench.

title: Kessler Auto invoice
body:
WORK ORDER 2291 — 12V battery, installed. Customer never collected.

Someone scrawled underneath: "Chained the garage. Bites in the office. Don't open it. — R.K."

title: Trucker's log
body: Route 17 is solid wrecks from the overpass to the Gas-N-Go. Half these tanks are still full. If you've got a hose and a strong stomach, there's fuel up here for a month.

title: Pharmacist's note
body:
Locked the controlled stock in the back room. Key is in the laundromat register next door so nobody breaks in looking for it here.

I'm sorry, Dennis. I couldn't wait any longer.

title: Scrawled stash code
body: ELM ST CRATE behind #14 — combo 0-4-1-7. Water, ammo, meds. If you find this, I'm dead, so help yourself. — K

title: Hunter's journal
body: Bows don't make noise. That's the whole lesson. Limbs from leaf springs, a stock from a fence post, a trigger from a mousetrap. Diagram on the next page.

title: St. Agnes memo: quarantine protocol
body:
ALL STAFF: Patients presenting with fever after a bite are to be moved to the basement isolation ward. Staff keycards required for the stairwell. Do not open the stairwell for anyone without a keycard. — Admin

Someone added in pen: "there's something BIG down there now"

title: Spray-painted flyer
body:
NORTHGATE BRIDGE IS A TOLL ROAD
PAY: 50 CANS OR 1 GUN
OR SWIM
— {tollmen}

title: Westside grand re-opening flyer
body:
WESTSIDE STRIP MALL — pharmacy, laundromat, Discount Den. Open late! Free parking!

Someone circled the pharmacy in red marker.

title: Firehouse 9 duty roster
body:
WATCH: Vera (nights), Pike (scouting — OVERDUE, Gas-N-Go)
WATER: Gus
MEDICAL: Doc
KITCHEN: everybody, see the board. Nobody eats if nobody brings food in.
— R.O.

title: Radio transcript, scribbled
body:
"...Northgate yard... one train... diesel's enough for one run... leaving when it's full or when the dead get through the fence, whichever comes first..."

Someone underlined "one run" three times.

title: Jo's recorder
body:
Static, then her voice, thin and steady.

"Sam. If you're hearing this, you came looking, because you're an idiot and I love you.

Day five. They sealed us down here with the bitten. Most of them turned. I didn't. I don't think I'm sick. I think I'm just lucky.

There's talk of a train out of Northgate. I'm going to try for it. The bridge is held by men with rifles who charge a toll. I'll find a way.

Don't stay in this city. Follow me. Grease monkey."

The tape runs out.
